sloka: रावणश्च मया दृष्टः क्षितौ तैलसमुक्षितः ।रक्तवासाः पिबन् मत्तः करवीरकृतस्रजः ।। ५.२७.२२।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaśca mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kṣitau tailasamukṣitaḥ ।raktavāsāḥ piban mattaḥ karavīrakṛtasrajaḥ ।। 5.27.22।।।।

translations.english: "I saw the body of Ravana lying on the ground smeared with oil, clad in red, wearing a garland of lilies and intoxicated with drinking.
